dedupe_keys.name: dpshtrr open data statistics on registered vehicles driving licences and road safety in albania

description: DPSHTRR, Albania's General Directorate of Road Transport Services, runs an open data platform with statistics from its vehicle and driver registers. The page read on 2026-09-28 describes an online platform giving, for the first time, public access to statistics on registered vehicles and driving licences in Albania, on the services the directorate provides and on road safety, presented as figures, percentages and charts for individuals, businesses and institutions doing research; the data come from DPSHTRR's own systems and are updated continuously, with an English version of the platform. Coverage is national. Access is free to view; no licence or bulk download format is stated on the page read. Caveats: the breakdowns available (by vehicle type, age, fuel, district) were not opened, and road safety figures come from the transport services directorate, not the police. It supports vehicle fleet and demand inputs for road network capacity planning and traffic simulation in Albania. Related record: data-akep-albania-electronic-communications-statistical-indicators is another Albanian regulator source.
